subject: 🏃 Sunday — 16 mi Long Run w/ 8 @ MP (Wk 9)
html:
Tomorrow's the biggest run of the V6 build: 16 miles with the back 8 at marathon pace — Week 9 of 12, three weeks to race day. The workout: 8 mi easy by HR (Z2, 140–150) → 8 mi @ MP (HR 150–160; ~7:35–7:45 readout) on the hilly home route — HR governs, let pace float on the hills. Pre-run: 5-min activation (quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks, glute bridges) + quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side).

The #1 priority tomorrow is fueling at effort. Jun 29 proved 71 g/hr works at easy pace — now it has to work at MP. Fuel plan: Maurten DM 160 in the handheld, Gel 100 every ~25 min, 2× CAF 100 in the back half → 70–80 g/hr. Take at least 2 gels during the MP block at HR 150–160 — that's the remaining validation before the Jul 12 dress rehearsal. Self-supported: hydration vest with water-only + ½ LMNT (~500 mg sodium per 16–20 oz), drink ~4 oz every 15–20 min.

H10 is critical — you left it home for BC, so charge it tonight and confirm "Polar H10 — Connected" in Watch Settings → Bluetooth before heading out. Knee's been 1/5 all week; the faint hamstring hint from Jul 1's threshold reps is worth monitoring — if it sharpens during the MP block, drop to easy and finish the distance.

Focus cue: take the gel before you don't want to. Pre-load the first MP-block gel a few minutes before the tempo starts, when appetite is still cooperating — that's the Presidio lesson.

Lay out everything tonight (vest, handheld, gels with CAFs accessible, H10 strap), have a light carb snack 30–45 min pre-run, and get to bed by 10.
